fieldData.main-content:
Season 1 of Radix Rewards is almost here, and it’s time to reveal what’s on the line.

The baseline reward pool for Season 1 is set at 100 million XRD. On top of that, up to another 100 million XRD can be unlocked through ecosystem milestones that we, as a community, achieve together. That means Season 1 has the potential to deliver a 200 million XRD reward pool.

With milestone bonuses, everyone shares in the upside when the Radix ecosystem grows. More transactions, more liquidity, more wallet downloads; each milestone achieved adds more XRD to the pool for all participants. On Radix, growth is collective, and so are the rewards.

Community Milestone Structure

These bonuses are triggered by network-wide achievements during the season. Hitting them increases the total Season 1 pool, which is then distributed based on each user’s Season Points.

The milestone bonuses for Season 1 are below:

Total Value Locked (TVL)

Measured via https://defillama.com/chain/radix. Value must be the average amount for a week during the season.

  • $10 million: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • $25 million: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • $50 million: 10M XRD added to season reward pool

‍

Average Weekly Transactions

Measured across all weeks of the season

  • 150K weekly transactions: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • 300K weekly transactions: 10M XRD added to season reward pool

‍

DEX Volume

Cumulative amount of DEX volume on pools tracked on Radix Rewards.

  • $150m total volume: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • $300m total volume: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • $500m total volume: 10M XRD added to season reward pool

‍

Radix Wallet Downloads

Total downloads of the Radix wallet on iOS and Android (currently 198k).

  • 300k total downloads: 10M XRD added to season reward pool
  • 500k total downloads: 10M XRD added to season reward pool

‍

How It Works

  1. Your DeFi activity earns Season Points (SP).
  2. When milestones are hit, extra XRD is added to the pool.
  3. At the end of the season, rewards are distributed based on SP.
  4. Existing positions on Ociswap, CaviarNine, DeFiPlaza, Root Finance, and WEFT Finance will automatically start earning SP when Season 1 begins.

‍

Enrollment Details

Registration is open now at incentives.radixdlt.com for Season 1. It only takes two minutes, and you’ll be ready to earn from day one.

Requirements:

  • Minimum $50 XRD/LSUs across linked accounts
  • XRD holdings provide up to 3x point multipliers
  • Enrollment takes under 2 minutes

‍

Early enrollment ensures you're positioned to earn from day one when Season 1 begins. 

Next Steps

Visit incentives.radixdlt.com to enroll and prepare for Season 1. Download the Radix Wallet at wallet.radixdlt.com if needed.

Season 1 launches by the end of August 2025.

For complete details on how Season Points work, visit our ELI5 guide.
